name: io.nana800/mcp-server
title: nana800
description: Build and manage nana800.io no-code workflows, analytics charts, dashboards and exports

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: nana800.io API key. Create or copy it at https://cloud.nana800.io/settings

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default project ID, used when a tool call does not pass project_id

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SCHEME_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default scheme (workflow) ID, used when a tool call does not pass scheme_id

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ANALYTICS_ORG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default analytics org ID, used when a tool call does not pass org_id. List your orgs with analytics_orgs_list
